vintage: curated 2026-07-14 from the community/zoning sweep (research/mpc-sweep-2026-07-14.md); point events where commercial development is landing — rezonings, grocery anchors, retail waves. Display-only.

list.note: 99,000 sf Kroger Marketplace at SE corner of N Custer Rd & Laud Howell Pkwy (groundbreaking Feb 2026) + 45,000 sf retail with SIX pad sites for small shops/restaurants/service/MEDICAL uses; 127-ac PD also carries ~300 SF homes + 11 ac multifamily. Textbook vet de-novo pad window.
Six retail centers announced/underway across Prosper (CI roundup Jan 2026); P&Z also approved a corner gas-station zoning exception Jul 2026 — town is loosening corner-commercial rules.

list.n: First commercial PD on the DNT extension
list.note: ~20 ac rezoned to PD w/ Dallas North Tollway Overlay at future Clear Creek Pkwy x future DNT (Ewing Buick GMC dealership) — first commercial anchors landing on the DNT alignment, the corridor Legacy Hills fronts.
City EDC plans a 33-ac mixed-use development near downtown Celina.

Approved 21-ac final phase of the $2.2B Lakeside Village (80% complete): 132 townhomes + hotel + 43,000 sf retail + plazas; town granted ~$5M/7yr incentive for hotel+retail. Retail densification signal for the Grapevine lakefront.
Universal Kids Resort projected to open 2026 inside Fields — a regional traffic anchor for the Frisco/PGA corridor.

list.n: H-E-B + 500k sf retail at Furst Ranch
list.note: H-E-B committed within the 2,300-ac Furst Ranch plan alongside ~500k sf of retail — the trade-area starting gun for southwest Flower Mound / Argyle.
